query:
SELECT id, foreign_entity_source AS source, foreign_entity_id AS github_key,
                       updated_at, metadata
                FROM foreign_entity
                WHERE foreign_entity_source = $1::text
                  AND left(lower(foreign_entity_id), length($2::text)) = lower($2::text)
                  AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR id > $3)
                ORDER BY id ASC
                LIMIT $4
